spec.title: Next token: T = 0.5, then top-2
spec.aria: A table of one decoding step for tokens A, B, C, D: logits 2.0, 1.0, 0.5, −1.0 divided by 0.5 give 4.0, 2.0, 1.0, −2.0; softmax gives probabilities 0.842, 0.114, 0.042, 0.002; top-2 keeps A and B and renormalises them to 0.881 and 0.119.
